text:
anya: CISO asked to reduce eu-west keystore audit exports to cut S3 egress. Idea: sample noisy enrichment events, keep auth/grants full. Need ops risk sync.

matt: We should avoid blind sampling of keystore decrypts. In staging we missed intermittent KMS 504s when sampling was on. That delayed GPU node joins.

irene: Proposal: 48h canary in eu-west-1a at 50% + synthetic decrypt probe that runs every 30s. If probe fails 3x in 5m -> auto-revert to 100% and page SRE.

ops-oncall: Runbook snippet: patch configmap to set sampling for the canary pool, snapshot current raw logs to short-term bucket before change. CLI: `kubectl -n infra-telemetry patch cm audit-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"eu-west-1a.keystore.sampling":"0.5"}}'`

anya: Telemetry: add Prom alerts for `keystore_decrypt_error_rate` and `gpu_join_retry_rate`. Auto-revert threshold: decrypt_error_rate > 0.3% over 5m. Keep events with fields user_token, grant_id, cross_account unsampled.

matt: Also try exporter compression (snappy) + event dedupe first; if that reduces payload by >25% we can avoid sampling.

audit-bot: Created ticket SEC-2026-420. Assignees: anya (owner), ops-oncall (runbook), matt (compliance). Link: https://redwood.internal/sec/SEC-2026-420

ops-oncall: Will post full runbook + snapshot job to the ticket in 20m and test rollback in staging.

anya: Action items recap and timeline: run exporter bench today, canary ready after staging test, compliance blurb by EOD. If probes fail, revert immediately.
